mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flow_llm_call (call_id, turn_id, session_id, exec_id, node_id, purpose, provider, model_name, streaming, request_body, status) VALUES (#{callId}, #{turnId}, #{sessionId}, #{execId}, #{nodeId}, #{purpose}, #{provider}, #{modelName}, #{streaming}, CAST(#{requestBodyJson} AS jsonb), 'RUNNING')
mapper.update: UPDATE flow_llm_call SET response_body = CAST(#{responseBodyJson} AS jsonb), response_text = #{responseText}, input_tokens = #{inputTokens}, output_tokens = #{outputTokens}, total_tokens = #{totalTokens}, finish_reason = #{finishReason}, status = #{status}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, latency_ms = #{latencyMs}, finished_at = now() WHERE call_id = #{callId}
mapper.select: SELECT call_id, exec_id, node_id, purpose, provider, model_name, streaming, request_body::text AS request_body, response_body::text AS response_body, response_text, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, finish_reason, status, error_msg, latency_ms, started_at FROM flow_llm_call WHERE turn_id = #{turnId} ORDER BY started_at
